entries.text: A weapon with working damage but no bound use-animation FEELS broken to the player - author idle+use clips at bind time and match the thrust keyframes to the behavior windup/active window.

Primitive-part weapons read below the average-game bar - build weapon visuals with generate_mesh (Cube) + save_mesh, keep prompts SLENDER-specific for blades (broad leaf blades come back as shovels), and verify the silhouette by capture before toolifying.

Held-item grips MUST be fitted in a guard-pose lab (posed rig + live Tool.Grip edits + captures from side AND front AND the player's behind-camera) - a numerically-set grip is wrong until seen; long weapons need the cross-carry (pre-yaw -35, pitch -50, rz-90, hilt offset) and short blades the horizontal stab carry (rz90 at the hilt).
A weapon angled straight FORWARD is foreshortened to invisibility from the player's default behind-camera - verify item readability from the behind view specifically, not just side views.
